exposure: Pharmacological labor induction with intravaginal prostaglandin E2 gel
cohort: 200 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies, cephalic fetal presentation, and elective labor induction at 41 weeks gestation (induction group) or spontaneous labor at ≥ 40 weeks gestation (control group)
finding: Primiparous women whose labor was induced spent a longer time in labor than women who presented in spontaneous labor.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was performed in 18 cases (17.5%), all in the induction group.
gest_age: 41 weeks gestation for induction group, ≥ 40 weeks gestation for spontaneous labor group
